In what order do the hooks run for a describe with 2 tests?
a: beforeAll -> beforeEach -> test 1 -> afterEach -> beforeEach -> test 2 -> afterEach -> afterAll

q: Which lines in a Playwright test need await?
a: Every line that talks to the browser: goto, click, fill, title(), textContent(), and every web-first assertion await expect(locator/page)...  (page.url() and creating a locator don't need it).

q: After recording with codegen, what do you clean up?
a: Full URLs -> relative; remove noise (click before fill, press Tab); check every locator is user-facing and stable; ADD assertions; read it aloud.

q: Error: Expected: "Login | QA Shop"  Received: Promise {}. What happened?
a: A missing await: you compared the Promise returned by page.title() (or similar), not its value.

q: Error: First argument must use the object destructuring pattern: 'page'. What happened?
a: You wrote async (page) => instead of async ({ page }) =>. Fixtures must be destructured.

q: Error: "context" and "page" fixtures are not supported in "beforeAll". Why?
a: beforeAll runs once for many tests, but each test gets its own new page. Do page work in beforeEach.

q: What is the difference between `timeout` and `expect.timeout` in playwright.config.ts?
a: timeout = max time for a whole test (30 s here). expect.timeout = how long ONE await expect(...) keeps retrying (5 s here).
